snippet.title: Ridge Racer 8 Switch Prototype - Gameplay
snippet.description:
Seems to date from late 2016/early 2017, looks pretty late in development, before polishing phase. Runs on UE4 (4.15 for Switch; before general availability).

It does appear to be a scraped RR8 that may have been intended to be released on the console's launch. Internal files reveals many RR7 references along with an actual RR8 logo (Game/Textures/UITextures/U_Prototype/Texture_Logo.tga) - https://imgur.com/yGOUhKl

Handles like any other mainline RR game. Some tracks crash the game, some others don't have surface collision completely figured out.

Recorded on Ryujinx (custom build w/ dev kit firmware).
